visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at a retail service counter, likely a cinema lobby. In front of her sits a large, elaborate Jurassic World themed popcorn bucket featuring a 3D T-Rex head bursting out of a tin base decorated with green foliage. (2) A man with long dark hair and a black bucket hat receives the bucket in a large plastic bag. He smiles broadly at the camera while holding the oversized item, his facial expressions showing excitement. (3) The setting shifts to an indoor living room with a couch and colorful pillows in the background. The camera focuses on a close-up of the tin bucket, showing detailed graphics of a T-Rex and branding. (4) The man's hands are seen removing the dinosaur head piece from its individual plastic wrap. The head is made of textured green material with yellow eyes and a wide-open red mouth. (5) He demonstrates the functionality of the dinosaur head as a hand puppet, sliding his arm into the base and manipulating the jaw. He makes playful, exaggerated biting motions towards his own hand. (6) The man then holds the dinosaur head up to his own face, positioning his mouth inside the puppet's mouth for a comedic effect, looking directly into the camera lens with wide eyes. (7) He concludes by holding the entire set together—the tin base and the dinosaur head—while explaining its features to the camera with high energy.
